tools.description: Free. One full risk card (the exact paid mint_risk_card shape) for a mint aged >= 300 s with >= 3 buys, delayed. Use it to see every field before paying. No arguments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_coverage, check_pumpfun_risk, check_watchlist_risk · Private data: check_pumpfun_risk, mint_risk_card, creator_reputation, wallet_profile, rhc_curve_card · Public sink: market_regime, wallet_profile, rhc_recent_launches, rhc_curve_card · Destructive: recent_launches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_coverage, check_pumpfun_risk, check_watchlist_risk · Private data: check_pumpfun_risk, mint_risk_card, creator_reputation, wallet_profile, rhc_curve_card · Public sink: market_regime, wallet_profile, rhc_recent_launches, rhc_curve_card · Destructive: recent_launches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
